run_get_clusters_kinetics: run the get_clusters function to extract video clusters from a Selavi checkpoint for Kinetics dataset
create_clusters_from_checkpoint: create cluster assignments from a PyTorch checkpoint and save them as a pickle file
build_kinetics_cluster_extractor: build a CLI tool that parses checkpoint labels and groups Kinetics video paths by cluster ID
test_get_clusters_function: test the get_clusters function with a checkpoint path and number of clusters argument
summarize_cluster_output: summarize the cluster output containing youtube IDs, time ranges, and ground truth classes per cluster
